claim: Famine belts and Jinshi core areas overlap only partially; the famine–Jinshi association is spatially heterogeneous.
The famine→Jinshi signal survives FDR in 48/135 grids and is concentrated in short horizons; famine severity is the strongest factor (q=0.337).
Sparse historical records become spatially explicit causal evidence through a transparent fuse→aggregate→infer pipeline.
GWR coefficients are mostly positive with a right tail; famine severity is concentrated in levels 2–4; normalized Jinshi records decline gently by exam year.
Normalizing the Jinshi rank field moves FDR discovery from 56/135 to 48/135 but leaves GWR coefficients nearly unchanged (r=0.991); the median significant lag shifts from 11 to 6.5 years.
